annotations.title: True-up — match the accrual to the settled amount

description: True-up an agreement — AFTER a settlement, match the accrual account to what was ACTUALLY settled. Posts ONE Adjustment (signed = settled − earned) in the CURRENT period so earned equals settled and the open balance nets to $0. Over-accrued → a negative Adjustment; under-accrued → a positive one. Always current-period, never backdated. Append-only and idempotent (a second run finds it already matched). Call WITHOUT confirm to DRY-RUN (shows the exact Adjustment and the before/after); call again with confirm:true to apply. This is also the first step of a close-out (close does the true-up then flags the agreement closed). Needs the agreement_id. Requires a connected Aurgus account.

confirm.description: Omit/false to DRY-RUN (preview the Adjustment); true to post it.

name: true_up
